thread:
Maria (CS): heads up — AtlasGrid renewal is due next month. They want to add 25 seats, but procurement insists on splitting invoices between AtlasGrid US and AtlasGrid EU. Need quick alignment on pricing and signature path.
Jake (AM): do we have a pricing precedent for split billing like this? last time we did an entity split it required two POs.
Oliver (Sales): pricing can stay the same per-seat, but we can offer a 2% early-pay discount if they commit to a single PO instead of two. might be easier ops-wise.
Emma (Finance): split invoices are okay but we need vendor codes for both entities and the billing addresses. also which entity will be on the contract? tax implications differ.
Maria (CS): procurement says EU team cannot pay US invoices due to internal policy. they want two invoices tied to two legal entities and separate signature authorities.
Raj (Legal): that means we need two contracting flows: either two amendments to the master subscription (one per entity) or a single amendment with an entity appendix. Advice: two amendments is cleaner for AU/EU tax. need to confirm signatory names and delegation docs.
Jake (AM): i'll ping the AtlasGrid procurement contact for signatory names and vendor codes. @Emma — can you share the vendor code template so they know what to send?
Emma (Finance): attaching template link: https://drive.redwood.ai/contracts/vendor-code-template.xlsx — send them that. we also need the EU VAT number.
Oliver (Sales): if they push back on two amendments, we can propose a single amendment with split billing schedule. sample schedule: 
```
- Invoice A (US entity): seats 1-50, monthly, USD
- Invoice B (EU entity): seats 51-75, monthly, EUR
- Billing start aligned to renewal date
```
Maria (CS): procurement also flagged e-signature routing: EU requires delegated signature by CFO, US by procurement lead. Can DocuSign handle two parallel envelopes?
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign can send parallel envelopes. Recommend creating two envelopes linked by "Related Envelopes" and include a shared amendment id in both. :white_check_mark:
Raj (Legal): i'll draft two short amendments — language will mirror each other and reference the master subscription id SUB-AG-4321. Please confirm both signers' full names & titles before I finalize.
Jake (AM): AtlasGrid replied — EU CFO is "Sofia Martinez", US procurement lead is "Ben Chu". Sending vendor codes and VAT in next email.
Emma (Finance): got vendor codes from AtlasGrid: US: VG-US-778, EU: VG-EU-119. VAT: EU VAT 123456789. i'll upload to the template and share the PDF.
Maria (CS): great. last operational ask: can we route invoices monthly for both entities? they requested monthly but finance prefers quarterly. Oliver — any leeway?
Oliver (Sales): push for monthly to reduce billing friction — tell them monthly for first 3 months, then review. i'll note the 2% early-pay discount option too.
Raj (Legal): once signers confirmed, i'll drop drafts by EOD. include this snippet in both amendments: "This Amendment applies solely to the legal entity identified herein and does not create cross-entity liability."
Maria (CS): perfect. i'll coordinate the DocuSign envelopes and the procurement thread. tagging @DocuSign Bot to create related envelopes once we have final PDFs. :thumbsup:
DocuSign Bot: will create two related envelopes when PDFs are uploaded to /contracts/AtlasGrid/renewal-1708509999/. Please ensure filenames: amendment_US.pdf and amendment_EU.pdf
Maria (CS): noted — everyone please confirm when you upload. thanks team.
